title: The session command gets no answer over the Windows named pipe
notes:
The comment says it: the `session` command is broken on Windows, not just its test. Both tests here drive the real `askApp` against the real `listenForSessions`, so the empty reply or timeout they get on `windows-latest` is what a worker pane gets when it runs `session ...` on Windows. The main session asks a worker to report back, and the call either says "the app answered with something that was not a reply" or hangs until it times out.

Tagged medium, not high, because the cause (the pipe not staying half open after the client's `end()`) is inferred and not yet reproduced outside CI. A likely fix, outside this PR, is to stop relying on half-close: the client writes the request followed by a newline and keeps its side open, and the server answers once it has read one line. That works the same over a unix socket and a named pipe. Then drop `halfOpenOnly`.
